{{Infobox |eng = Starfruit |seed = {{Name|Starfruit Seeds}} |growth = 13 days |season = Summer |xp = 43 [[Farming#Experience Points|Farming XP]] |sellprice = 750 |edibility = 50 |color = Yellow }} '''Starfruit''' is a [[Fruits|fruit]] [[Crops|crop]] that grows from [[Starfruit Seeds]] after 13 days. It has the second-highest sell price of any crop in the game, with only the [[Sweet Gem Berry]] selling for more. One Starfruit can be purchased each year at the [[Luau]] for {{Price|3000}}. ==Stages== {| class="wikitable roundedborder" style="text-align:center;" !Stage 1 !Stage 2 !Stage 3 !Stage 4 !Stage 5 !Harvest |- |style="vertical-align: bottom; padding-bottom: 8px;"|[[File:Starfruit Stage 1.png|center|link=]] |style="vertical-align: bottom; padding-bottom: 8px;"|[[File:Starfruit Stage 2.png|center|link=]] |style="vertical-align: bottom; padding-bottom: 8px;"|[[File:Starfruit Stage 3.png|center|link=]] |style="vertical-align: bottom; padding-bottom: 8px;"|[[File:Starfruit Stage 4.png|center|link=]] |style="vertical-align: bottom; padding-bottom: 8px;"|[[File:Starfruit Stage 5.png|center|link=]] |style="vertical-align: bottom; padding-bottom: 8px;"|[[File:Starfruit Stage 6.png|center|link=]] |- |2 Days |3 Days |2 Days |3 Days |3 Days |Total: 13 Days |- |} ==Crop Growth Calendar== {{#lst:Crop Growth Calendars|Starfruit}} ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Linus,Pam,Jodi,Kent,Leah,Shane,Elliott,Harvey,Sandy |neutral=Maru,Sebastian,Pierre,Caroline,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Emily,Sam,Marnie,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Willy,Krobus,Leo |dislike=Abigail,Haley,Jas,Vincent }} ==Bundles== Starfruit is one of the options in the {{Bundle|Dye Remixed||y}}. ==Recipes== Starfruit is not used in any recipes. ==Buildings== Starfruit is required to build a [[Junimo Hut]], purchased from the [[Wizard's Tower]]. {| class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description !Cost !Size |- |[[File:Junimo Hut.png|72px|center]] |[[Junimo Hut]] |{{Description|Junimo Hut}} |{{Price|20000}}{{Name|Stone|200}}{{Name|Starfruit|9}}{{Name|Fiber|100}} |style="text-align: center;"|'''3x2'''
[[File:Marker3x2.png|center]] |- |} ==Tailoring== Starfruit can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring#Pants|Genie Pants]]. [[File:Genie Pants.png|36px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== *[[Kent]] requests a Starfruit by mail on the 15th of [[Summer]] (year 2) in the [[Quests#A Soldier's Star|"A Soldier's Star" Quest]]. The reward is {{Price|500}} and 1 [[Friendship]] heart. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.1|Reduced value to {{Price|750}}, down from {{Price|800}}.}} {{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}} {{History|1.5|Iridium quality is now possible when using [[Deluxe Fertilizer]].
